Three years after her son mysteriously disappeared, a grieving mother begins experiencing disturbing visions that seem impossible to explain. When mirrors appear to reveal cracks between her reality and another parallel world, she becomes convinced that the truth about her son's disappearance may exist on the other side. As memories, hallucinations and reality begin to overlap, she is drawn into a dangerous mystery that also exposes hidden fractures within her marriage and family.
